faq.a: Kwame is associated with Akan. Kwame is Akan (Ghanaian), meaning 'born on Saturday'. It is used as a male given name.
No — the underlying form is Akan, not Arabic.
Kwame can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Akan-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Kwame, kwame. Script forms are كْوَمِي, کوامي, کوامی, क्वामे.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
